name: Simco Automotive Inc.
old_description: Our staff is there to ensure you have an enjoyable experience. They have decades of experience between them, so don't be afraid to get your questions answered! We are dedicated to providing the best quality auto body parts in the aftermarket market. With locations in Houston, Dallas, and Beaumont, we can serve you almost anywhere in Texas.
about:
Simco Automotive Inc. operates from Houston, Texas, with additional branches in Dallas and Beaumont. The company has served the aftermarket automotive industry for over two decades, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. Ownership structure and founder names have not been made public.

The business functions as a wholesaler and distributor of aftermarket auto body parts, cooling products, and lighting components. Its inventory includes front bumper covers, fenders, headlights, radiator fan assemblies, and condenser fan assemblies for vehicles such as the Honda Accord, Toyota Tundra, and Jeep Grand Cherokee. Simco stocks parts certified by NSF and CAPA and emphasizes a dependable delivery network across Texas.

The company supplies collision repair shops, dealerships, and independent buyers throughout Texas. Its catalog covers a range of makes and models, with parts identified by Partslink numbers, and the firm positions itself as a resource for both professional installers and retail customers.

Simco cites its membership in the Aftermarket Body Parts Association (ABPA) as a way to stay current with industry trends. The company’s stated mission is to become the premier provider of aftermarket automotive parts in Texas by combining competitive pricing, high‑quality brand parts, and responsive customer service.
